name: legate
description: Delegated work orchestration for agent sessions. Dispatch work into tmux windows running Claude or Codex, then debrief, watch, show logs, stop, or attach.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch and manage delegated agent work in tmux
interface.longDescription: Dispatch work into tmux windows running Claude or Codex. Debrief progress, watch for meaningful changes, show recent pane output, stop delegated work, and attach to a window when you want to take over.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch delegated agent work for this task.
Show logs for the active delegated handle.
